# Muraqabah Initiative

> Muraqabah Initiative connects seekers to traditional Islamic scholarship, meaningful spiritual formation, and sincere community service in the Greater Toronto Area and online.

Muraqabah Initiative Inc. is based in the Greater Toronto Area, Ontario, Canada. Classes are taught live on Zoom and in person in Ontario. Contact: info@muraqabah.ca

## Teachers
- [Shaykh Zakaria AbdilAziz](https://www.muraqabah.ca/teachers/shaykh-zakaria-abdilaziz/): Head of Muraqabah’s academic vision and a graduate of the Alimiyyah program at Dar al-Mustafa in Tarim, Yemen, where he spent nearly two decades immersed in the traditional curriculum.
- [Shaykh Nuh Sanders](https://www.muraqabah.ca/teachers/shaykh-nuh-sanders/): Raised in Philadelphia and trained for more than six years as a full-time student at Dar al-Mustafa in Tarim, Yemen. He teaches Chains of Trust, Muraqabah’s course in the foundations of Hadith sciences.
- [Dr. Ali Hussain](https://www.muraqabah.ca/teachers/dr-ali-hussain/): A scholar of Islamic spirituality and the legacy of Shaykh Muhyi al-Din Ibn al-Arabi, with a PhD in Islamic Mysticism from the University of Michigan and traditional study at Dar al-Mustafa in Tarim under Habib Umar bin Hafiz.

## Programs
- [The Art of Seeking](https://www.muraqabah.ca/programs/the-art-of-seeking/): A guided study with Dr. Ali Hussain of Shaykh Muhyi al-Din Ibn al-Arabi’s Kunh Mā Lā Budda li-l-Murīd Minh (Advice for the Seekers). Saturdays at 10 AM EST, live on Zoom.
- [Gardens of Paradise](https://www.muraqabah.ca/programs/gardens-of-paradise/): A weekly study circle with Shaykh Zakaria AbdilAziz. The opening series, Weight of Words, turns to how we speak. Weekly online, with a monthly in-person gathering in Guelph.
- [Chains of Trust](https://www.muraqabah.ca/programs/chains-of-trust/): Foundations of Hadith Sciences. A guided, line-by-line study of Al-Bayquniyyah with Shaykh Nuh Sanders. Live online via Zoom.
- [Spheres of Faith](https://www.muraqabah.ca/programs/spheres-of-faith/): Our flagship weekly class on Islam, Iman, Ihsan, and Irfan, taught live by Shaykh Zakaria from Tarim, Yemen. Recordings are on our YouTube channel.
